title: Support of a binary vector
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every vector $\gamma\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, the finite set corresponding to $\gamma$ under the binary-cube-to-finite-set equivalence is exactly $\{i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n):\gamma_i\ne0\}$.
